 Jan 18, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) controls the ball against the Toronto Raptors during the first half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images 
 The Los Angeles Lakers return home Sunday night to face the Toronto Raptors in an intriguing cross-conference matchup at Crypto.com Arena, with both teams looking to bounce back from losses.
 Dec 4, 2025; Toronto, Ontario, CAN; Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves (15) passes the ball away from Toronto Raptors forward Scottie Barnes (4) and guard Jamal Shead (23) in the second half at Scotiabank Arena. Mandatory Credit: Dan Hamilton-Imagn Images
 How to Watch Lakers vs Raptors
 When: Sunday, November 1, 2026
 Time: 9:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: Spectrum SportsNet
 Live Stream: DIRECTV ( try for free )
 Los Angeles enters the contest with a 4-2 record after suffering a 112-95 defeat against the Golden State Warriors on Friday night. Luka Doncic has been spectacular to begin the season, averaging more than 36 points per game while serving as the centerpiece of the Lakers’ offense. Austin Reaves has also been a major contributor, averaging more than 24 points per contest, while Walker Kessler has provided a valuable presence in the paint. The Lakers will look to get back on track against a Toronto team they have defeated in seven consecutive meetings.
 Toronto comes into Sunday’s matchup at 3-2 after falling 121-114 to the Orlando Magic despite a career-high 41 points from Scottie Barnes. The Raptors have leaned heavily on Barnes, RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley, particularly with Kawhi Leonard sidelined due to a knee injury. Toronto will need another strong performance from its offensive leaders to keep pace with a dangerous Los Angeles lineup. The Raptors will look to snap their losing streak against the Lakers when the teams tip off at 9 p.m. ET on Sunday.
